item.title: IWD event focuses on 'Finding the Balance'
item.description: International Women’s Day 2026 in Wimmera will be celebrated on Tuesday, March 10, at Horsham Town Hall Theatre with Finding the Balance.The official proceedings will begin at 12.15pm, but the women and allies are invited to pause, reflect, and connect at 12pm.A light lunch will be provided, and a free guided tour of the Horsham Regional Art Gallery will be offered at 11.30 am.This year's event acknowledges the external demands and internal load that many women carry.Facilitated by Ellen Jackson

item.title: Cawood cycling for cancer research
item.description: A former Horsham local will cycle 1400 kilometres from Canberra to Hobart next month to raise funds for cancer research as part of the Tour de Cure’s 2026 Signature Tour.Daniel Cawood, now based in Mildura, is WFI Insurance's state manager for Victoria. item.title: Family Fun
item.description: In our demanding and digital world, families find themselves travelling and going to and from one commitment to another.Often focused around the needs of the children, it seems an endless round of doing, but so often it is chid-focused and doesn't really engage the whole family.When do families get time to do things together and have fun at the same time?Come and C-church has you covered!With activities, stories, songs and food, it gives families a chance to get together in a relaxed environment

item.title: Cycling veteran rolls back into Horsham
